primary_areas.label: Live Overview
primary_areas.description: Current conditions, live events, and source-aware monitoring.

primary_areas.label: Places & Systems
primary_areas.description: Country, regional, economic, legal, scientific, humanitarian, resource, and thematic context.

primary_areas.label: Analysis
primary_areas.description: Comparative, spatial, Earth-observation, harmonization, model, and scenario workflows.

primary_areas.label: Evidence & Research
primary_areas.description: Discovery, audit, research paths, evidence synthesis, relationships, provenance, and saved state.

primary_areas.label: Publishing & Monitoring
primary_areas.description: Briefings, publications, digests, monitoring, and institutional review workspaces.

primary_areas.label: Methods & Operations
primary_areas.description: API integration, workflows, federation, governance, access, and product documentation.

canonical_contracts.label: Route and cross-view state
canonical_contracts.principle: One selected geography and compatible analytical state can move across workspaces without silent substitution.

canonical_contracts.label: Data truth and record provenance
canonical_contracts.principle: Source eligibility, observed coverage, freshness, record transformations, and missingness remain explicit.

canonical_contracts.label: Comparative and model assurance
canonical_contracts.principle: Comparability, assumptions, sensitivity, uncertainty, and model limitations are disclosed before interpretation.

canonical_contracts.label: Research and product handoffs
canonical_contracts.principle: Evidence packets retain provenance and require explicit human confirmation before external delivery.

canonical_contracts.label: Publication and export
canonical_contracts.principle: Frozen evidence, methodology, limitations, review state, and prior versions remain attached to durable outputs.

canonical_contracts.label: Operations and governance
canonical_contracts.principle: Production security, monitoring, review governance, and performance are enforced without hidden visitor profiles.

compatibility.deprecation_policy: Public routes and contracts remain preserved in v4.31.0; Orbital Earth extends the existing Earth route without adding a new top-level route.

boundaries: The six primary areas organize existing workspaces; they do not collapse distinct evidence types or methodologies.
Search relevance, model outputs, alerts, and scenario results are not automated decisions or authoritative conclusions.
Missing, stale, historical, modeled, and contextual records remain visibly distinct.
Public access does not require a hosted user profile.
Cross-product handoffs and publication remain human-confirmed and review-gated.
Orbital Earth uses registered satellite imagery products but does not fabricate live spacecraft positions, pass-specific ground tracks, or sensor swaths.
